# HOLD THE TABLE

Found your own empire anywhere in your real room — name it, draw its banner with a fingertip, then hold it against the siege, hands only.

A seated, hands-only mixed-reality empire-building and siege-defense game for **Meta Quest 3 / 3S**, made for the Meta VR Start Developer Competition 2026 (Gaming track, New Experience).

## How it plays

1. **Name it.** An Imperial Scroll unfurls beside you over passthrough. Poke one of three fictional civilizations (Celestial Dynasty, Verdant Clans, Iron Dominion) and type your empire's name.
2. **Draw it.** Pick banner colors and draw your emblem with your index finger (undo, clear, two brush sizes).
3. **Place it.** Pull the miniature Town Hall out of the scroll and set it on any real surface MRUK finds: a table, a sideboard, the floor. A green or red ghost shows whether the footprint is supported and clear; far spots are picked with a hand ray and a pinch. Your drawing waves on a cloth banner beside the hall.
4. **Hold it.** Pinch walls, archer towers and barricades from a tray to grow the settlement. Three waves march in on curved paths (the last brings a Ram). Sweep both palms outward for a shockwave (two charges). Between waves a Quartermaster offers upgrades based on what you built. Poke RESTART to replay with the same empire.

No controller is needed at any step.

## Tech

- Unity 6000.6.9f1, URP, Android / IL2CPP / ARM64
- Meta XR Core SDK 209.0.0, Meta Interaction SDK 209.0.0 (hand grab, poke, ray, poke/ray canvases), Mixed Reality Utility Kit 209.0.0 (room surfaces), passthrough
- Procedural virtual-table fallback behind the same surface interface when no room scan is available
- All meshes, materials, UI and audio are generated in code; the scene is generated by an editor script and checked by a validator; fully offline

## Build

Open the project root in Unity 6000.6.9f1 with Android Build Support, then use the **HoldTheTable** menu:

- `Build Scene` — generates the scene (`Assets/Scripts/Editor/SceneBuilder.cs`)
- `Validate` — checks required components and references (`Assets/Scripts/Editor/Validator.cs`)
- `Build APK` — builds `Builds/HoldTheTable.apk` (`Assets/Editor/BuildScript.cs`)

Command line (with the project closed in the Editor):

```bash
Unity -quit -batchmode -projectPath . -executeMethod BuildScript.BuildApk -logFile build.log
```
